title: Compare what we said we would do with what we did
statement: As a developer reviewing a change, I can see which Plan the Review delivers and where the two differ, so I can judge a departure from the agreed approach instead of discovering it by accident.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Review can name the Plan it delivers, and each of the two pages links to the other.
The comparison lists every Plan slide that no slide of its delivering Reviews accounts for, and every slide of those Reviews that accounts for no Plan slide.
A Review's author can record why the work departed from a named Plan slide, and a reader sees that reason beside that slide.
The comparison only reports: it never blocks a merge, changes a review decision, or changes a Plan's state.
